author: Kenney
purpose: Shared CC0 source recordings for controlled-soldier surface contacts and the frozen diagnostic audition. Not rifle audio.

runtimeProcessing.method: Decode locally at 24kHz, average channels, trim from the original contact onset, remove DC, peak bound to 0.7, apply 0.5ms attack and 25ms release fades.
limitations: Earth temporarily uses the grass recording; not a verified dirt or period military boot recording.
One original recording per surface with subtle pitch variation; not a multi-take Foley library.
Crawling retains the original synthetic friction. Only the controlled soldier's contact events use these recordings.
